build_natural_instructions_dataset: build a TensorFlow dataset from the Natural Instructions v2 benchmark tasks
download_natural_instructions_data: download Natural Instructions task JSON files from the AllenAI GitHub repository
generate_natural_instructions_examples: generate examples from Natural Instructions task JSON files with id, input, output, source, task_name, and definition fields
create_natural_instructions_split: create a TRAIN split from all 1700+ Natural Instructions tasks for model fine-tuning
configure_natural_instructions_features: configure dataset features with id, input, output, source, task_name, and definition text fields
